facts.business: HRS Aluglaze Limited is an integrated player in the architectural facade and fenestration industry engaged in the design, manufacturing, supply, and installation of aluminium products and facade systems including windows, doors, curtain walls, cladding, and glazing systems for residential, commercial, industrial, and institutional projects.

segments.name: Architectural facade and fenestration (aluminium windows, doors, curtain walls, cladding, glazing systems)

capacity_or_capex.item: Proposed expansion of manufacturing facility at Rajoda, Ahmedabad
capacity_or_capex.timeline: Proposed expansion of approximately 13,714 square metres adjoining existing 11,176 sq. m. facility

capacity_or_capex.timeline: FY2025-26 (amount utilised: Rs 1,139.52 lakhs; unutilised: Rs 690.28 lakhs)

FY2025-26 (amount utilised: Rs 761.30 lakhs; unutilised: Rs 0.74 lakhs)

key_risks: Concentration in core market (Gujarat) with new geographic expansion risks
Execution risk in technically demanding high-specification industrial facade projects (e.g., Micron Semiconductor Facility)
Integration risk from acquisition of Geotrix Building Envelope business and new subsidiary Geotrix Private Limited
Dependence on key personnel (Mr. Selvam Ramanathan's 35 years domain expertise)
Regulatory compliance risk (charges with RoC yet to be registered/satisfied for NBFC loans)
Working capital intensity and project execution delays
facts.related_party_note: The slump sale acquisition of Geotrix Building Envelope Pvt. Ltd. assets (Rs 16.7 Crores) was noted as 'Related Party: NA'. The acquired assets are licensed to subsidiary Geotrix Pvt. Ltd. via exclusive Strategic License Agreement valued at Rs 80.4 lakhs per annum. Company holds 67% equity in Geotrix Pvt. Ltd., remaining 33% held by Ms. Snega Selvam.
